items.title: Eddie Palmieri — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: when David Perez is coming out of the service... he takes it, and then David stays, and he’s an incredible bass player, too... And that’s La Perfecta.

ctx.x: He had to be the tallest bellhop on the planet.

Now he comes to play in ‘62, when I open up there with my own band, and he came up in his Bentley. What a transition a couple of years made. So the main thing is that now I’m ready to go up there. Mike says, “Listen, Eddie, Manny Oquendo is not working.” Manny Oquendo had been playing with the charanga of Pacheco. Whatever band Manny Oquendo played with, “el zoomo.” But he’s playing timbales with Pacheco, and that band was happening. But for whatever reason, he left, and he’s not working. Pacheco already had…
What’s the repertoire? Are you writing all the music?
